_note: UIUC 2026 talk — the rig runs the INTRO only; the rest of the talk is Keynote. Copied from shows/CNMAT_openlab/config.json; title and capabilities differ.
title: shm @ UIUC 2026
_micOnStart: Camera and mic are separate getUserMedia grants, so "it's showtime!" asks for both. This show has mic-driven puppets (bounce + talk frames) and nothing about them works without it — better one extra prompt at boot than a dead puppet on stage.
_capabilities: `hands` for every hand puppet; `face` for hats/headings; `faceLabels` (face-api.js, a SECOND ML runtime) for the green #b4dd13 name box around your face. `potato` is dropped — nothing in the intro uses it. Everything here loads eagerly at boot, so trim it once the script settles.
